mapper.select: /*selectReportResultList*/ SELECT A.REPORT_NO , A.GROUP_CODE , A.GROUP_NAME , A.CLOSE_MONTH , A.STATUS , A.TR_YN , A.TRDT_YN , A.CONTRACT_YN , A.RD_YN , A.BUYER_CA_RD_YN , A.PD_YN , A.BUYER_CA_PD_YN , A.DE_CD_YN , A.DE_WD_YN , A.RE_CD_YN , A.RE_WD_YN , A.EVALUATION_YN , A.BUYER_INFO , A.PRINT_DATE , A.ADD_DATE , A.ADD_USER_ID , A.CHANGE_DATE , A.CHANGE_USER_ID , A.CANCEL_NOTE FROM KEP.KEP_REPORT_DT A WHERE A.REPORT_NO IN ( SELECT B.PO_NO FROM KEPMGPDT B WHERE B.BUYER = #{COMPANY} AND B.PM_NO = #{DOCU_NO} ) ORDER BY A.GROUP_NAME
